title: PesaCast webhook payload
description: The JSON body the PesaCast phone or desktop app POSTs to your webhook. Receivers must ignore unknown properties; new optional properties may be added without changing schema_version.

schema_version.description: Version of this payload format. Incremented only for incompatible changes.

device_id.description: A random identifier created once per app install. Use it to tell phones or desktops apart. It is not a secret and changes if the app is reinstalled.

exported_at.description: When the app built this request (UTC, ISO-8601).

test.description: Present and true on the connectivity check sent by the app's "Save & send test" button. Such a request has no transactions and must not be recorded.

direction.description: Kind of transaction. New values may be added; treat an unknown one as "other".
